description: This PHP script contains functions for checking database settings during the installation of SuiteCRM, including validation of database credentials, names, and connection tests, as well as session management for installation parameters.

methods.name: checkDBSettings
methods.description: Validates database configuration parameters, tests database connectivity, and checks for existing databases and tables during SuiteCRM installation.

methods.name: printErrors
methods.description: Outputs validation errors or success message after database checks.

methods.name: copyInputsIntoSession
methods.description: Copies user input from request parameters into session variables for persistent configuration during installation.
